name: Hime to Otome no Yakimochi LOVE
source:
The former girls’ school Kokoronomori Gakuen recently became co-ed, but girls still greatly outnumber boys. Kazuki is the son of the school’s chairman and serves as the student council president. However, only he knows that his father had disappeared after incurring grave debts and that he is also acting as the chairman. His childhood friend and vice-president of the student council Sara and former student council leader Nanoka began to suspect something was amiss.

At that time, a group of exchange students arrived from overseas. It was another one of his childhood friends, the princess Alize, and her attendant Majoroline. The students’ excitement seeing these mysterious foreigners was palpable, and it became even more chaotic when Alize suddenly kissed him in front of the whole school.

“I’ve always dreamed of the day when I would be able to meet you once more”

Majoroline explained that the school had been formally acquired by the Kingdom of Stanhal to serve as a cross-cultural bridge between the two nations. He was greeted by them when he returned home, and had no option but to live with them since he was saddled with debt. His co-habitation life with the deeply-in-love Alize begins.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/09/25/september-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
前女子学校“心之森学园”最近改为男女同校，但女生人数仍然远远多于男生。一树是学校董事长的儿子，担任学生会主席。然而，只有他知道，他的父亲负债累累后失踪了，而他又担任董事长。他的青梅竹马兼学生会副会长莎拉和前学生会会长奈诺卡开始怀疑有些不对劲。

这时，一群交换生从海外赶来。那是他的另一位儿时好友，艾莉兹公主和她的侍从马乔洛琳。看到这些神秘的外国人，学生们的兴奋之情溢于言表，而当艾莉丝突然在全校面前亲吻他时，气氛变得更加混乱。

“我一直梦想着有一天能够再次见到你”

马杰洛林解释说，这所学校已被斯坦哈尔王国正式收购，作为两国之间的跨文化桥梁。回到家后，他受到了他们的迎接，但由于负债累累，他只好和他们住在一起。他与深爱的艾莉兹的同居生活开始了。

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/09/25/september-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
